name: gitignore-check
title: Gitignore Check
description: Stops secrets and junk getting committed when a .gitignore only looks right: it runs Git's real matching rules against your files and names the line that decides each one, catching inline # comments, trailing tabs, leading spaces, backslashes and ./, ! lines that can't re-include a file inside an excluded folder or are overridden by a later line, / anchors that miss nested folders, .env, keys and node_modules left out, and already-committed files that .gitignore won't untrack (with the git rm --cached command), with one-tap fixes.
